items: suffix appended to nouns and adjectives to create a neuter noun, usually an abstract noun denoting a relation, social status, scientific discipline, quality or state: -hood, -ness, -ship, -ity, -y

Abstract noun suffix; forms part of larger suffixes such as -е́ние, -а́ние, -тие, and exists on its own especially as a suffix added to compound words. — много- (“many”) + о́браз (“image”) → многообра́зие (“variety, diversity”); ма́лый (“little”) + дух (“courage”) + -ие → малоду́шие (“cowardice”); плоский (“flat”) + стопа́ (“foot”) + -ие → плоскосто́пие (“flatfoot (medical condition)”)

blocks.text: The stress is drawn onto the preceding syllable (as in многообра́зие vs. о́браз).
A velar may turn into a palatal as a result of the Slavic first palatalization (as in малоду́шие).
